title: Home Trade vs Foreign Trade
text: Home trade is buying and selling within a country's borders (wholesale and retail). Foreign trade is trade between countries, made up of import trade, export trade, and entrepot (re-export) trade.

title: Channels of Distribution
text: A channel of distribution is the path goods take from producer to consumer, e.g. producer -> wholesaler -> retailer -> consumer. Shorter channels can mean lower prices but less market reach.

title: Types of Business Organization
text: Common forms include sole proprietorship (one owner, unlimited liability), partnership (two or more owners sharing liability), and limited company (separate legal entity, owners have limited liability).

title: Insurance Basics
text: Insurance is a system where a person pays a premium to an insurer, who agrees to compensate for specified losses (e.g. fire, theft), spreading risk across many policyholders.

title: Aids to Trade
text: Aids to trade are services that support commerce, including banking, insurance, transport, warehousing, communication, and advertising — all needed to move goods efficiently from producer to consumer.
